ov: المتحولون: آخر فارس (الإنجليزية: Transformers: The Last Knight) هو فيلم خيال علمي أكشن أمريكي أنتج في سنة 2017، يعتبر الفيلم خامس إصدار لسلسلة أفلام المتحولون، تم إخراج الفيلم عن طريق مايكل باي وهو مخرج فيلم المتحولون: عصر الانقراض وهو من بطولة مارك والبيرغ وستانلي توتشي وإيزابيلا منير وجوش دوهامل وسانتياغو كابريرا ولاورا هادوك.
plotEn:
In 484 AD, Merlin finds the Knights of Iacon, a group of Transformers hiding on Earth, seeking their help to aid King Arthur and his knights. They give him a staff and help Arthur defeat the Saxons, but warn Merlin to keep it hidden.
In the present day, following the events of Hong Kong, Optimus Prime arrives on the ruins of Cybertron and meets the Cybertronian goddess Quintessa, who brainwashes him into becoming Nemesis Prime and sends him to Earth to retrieve Merlin's staff, which will restore Cybertron by taking energy from Earth's core, which is actually Unicron, also a Transformer and Cybertron's ancient enemy.
On Earth, a new paramilitary task force called the Transformers Reaction Force (TRF) continues to hunt Transformers. Some U.S. military personnel who work with the TRF, including former NEST members Colonel William Lennox and General Morshower, reluctantly oppose its actions. Cade Yeager, now a fugitive, hides Transformer refugees in his junkyard. In a war-torn Chicago, Cade and Bumblebee meet a teenage scavenger named Izabella and her Transformer companion, Sqweeks, before encountering a dying Transformer who gives them a talisman. The TRF confronts Cade, but Bumblebee and Hound stop them, then let them go.
